provenance.method: Manual structural inspection of separately generated Microsoft Word and Aspose comparison outputs; this file is not regenerated by the minimal-pair refresh command.
provenance.countScope: Field-character counts are all w:fldChar descendants below w:del in each complete comparison output. Counts differ because the implementations choose different revision granularity; agreement means both place complete deleted-field scaffolding inside deletion, not that their document-wide counts are equal.
